reappearance_match_threshold.meaning: a latent of the paper's D=192 model reappears in a larger model if its maximum Pearson correlation of native activations with any live latent of that model, over the same windows, is >= 0.5; a live latent of the larger model is 'new' if its maximum correlation with every live latent of the paper's model is < 0.5

near_duplicate_threshold.meaning: a live latent is a near-duplicate if some other live latent of the same model correlates >= 0.8 with it

feature_selection_rule: per feature and run, the eligible latent with maximum AUROC (ties: lowest id); also reported: eligible maximum Sel. Eligible: nonconstant, TPR >= 0.05, active positives in >= 20 trials (macaque) or >= 20 episodes (Aeon). Native activity > 0, positive orientation.
